pooling.macro_time: folder hour after Cas9 delivery; not cut onset
pooling.within_hour_weight: equal unit after within-unit time averaging
pooling.uncertainty: between-unit sample SD; crop-cluster bootstrap 95% CI for model fits

support_only_filter.coordinates: finite observed endpoints on exact acquisition schedule

physical_time_harmonization.representative_per_unit_bin: supported curve point nearest bin center

msd.status: descriptive raw MSD; localization/motion-blur correction unavailable

vac.primary_delta: acquisition-specific integer frame offset nearest 10 s, constrained to 7.5-12.5 s

vcc.primary_object: lag-indexed normalized 2x2 matrix in source table
vcc.headline: mean of bidirectional rotation-invariant traces
vcc.fit: GCV smoothing spline for display only; no Rouse communication-time claim

warnings: 10-50 s spans only five-fold, so power-law exponents are weakly identified.
5 h has only about 10 Site1 trajectories and 9 paired bundles.
Acquisitions are pooled biologically but retain unequal cadence and movie length.
Tracking missingness can remain outcome-dependent at long lags.
